title: Agentic Economy Oracle parameters
description: Parameters this plugin exposes for a simulation run. Read-only in the registry (declared defaults). Interactive personalization arrives with the marketplace.

n_rounds.description: Number of MESA rounds per simulation run.

n_traders.description: Trading agents per round inside each agent's local MESA model.

strategy_distribution.description: Distribution of trading strategies assigned across the traders. Shapes the economic dynamics the oracle learns from.

oracle_target_signals.description: Macro signals the oracle attempts to predict.

oracle_min_training_graphs.description: Minimum graphs accumulated before a training run is allowed.
